subject: general
question: Who became the first woman fighter pilot to join the elite 18 'Flying Bullets' squadron in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mohana Singh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Squadron Leader** Mohana Singh **became the first woman fighter pilot to join the Indian Air Force's (IAF) 18 "Flying Bullets" squadron in 2024.
 
• The **"Flying Bullets" squadron **operates the LCA Tejas, India's Indigenous fighter jet
 
• Mohana Singh is **one of the first female fighter pilots in India. **
 
• She was part of the "**Tarang Shakti" exercise in Jodhpur**, where she flew in the LCA Tejas fighter jet. 
 
• During the exercise, **she instructed the Army and Navy Vice Chiefs** on the flight. 
 
• The exercise was a message of support for Make in India. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Avani Chaturvedi**

 
 
• One of India’s first three women fighter pilots.
 
• Commissioned in June 2016 in the Indian Air Force (IAF).
 
• First Indian woman to fly a solo fighter jet (MiG-21 Bison) in 2018.
 
• Born in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Graduate from the Indian Air Force Academy, Hyderabad.
 
 
 
• **Shivangi Singh**
 
 
• First woman fighter pilot to join the IAF's Rafale squadron in 2020.
 
• Part of the prestigious "Golden Arrows" Squadron.
 
• Hails from Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Commissioned in 2017 and previously flew MiG-21 Bisons.
 
 
 
• **Bhawana Kanth**
 
 
• One of India’s first three women fighter pilots.
 
• Commissioned in June 2016 in the IAF.
 
• Became combat-ready in May 2019, flying MiG-21 Bison.
 
• Born in Begusarai, Bihar.
 
• First woman fighter pilot to take part in the Republic Day parade flypast in 2021.
